description.value: Coastal campground on paved Hwy 14 at the Jordan River village, a well-known surf break and classic overnight on the Sooke–Port Renfrew cycling corridor; 23 sites with washrooms, but the vibe is surf-crowd busy rather than a quiet retreat.
